title: V ali na: v šoli, na pošti
description: Where you are and where you go: v/na + locative for a place (v šoli, na pošti) and v/na + accusative for a direction (grem v šolo, na pošto).

quest.story: Tone pelje naročilo v Gorico in na tržnico. Kam gre in kje je? Pomagaj mu s predlogi. · Tone is taking an order to Gorizia and to the market. Where is he going and where is he? Help him with the prepositions.

exercises.prompt: Otroci so ___ šoli. (The children are at school.)
exercises.explain: Buildings and rooms take v: v šoli, v kuhinji, v gostilni. The place ends in -i (locative).

exercises.prompt: Sem ___ pošti. (I'm at the post office.)
exercises.explain: Some places always take na: na pošti, na tržnici, na trgu, na postaji, na vrtu. Learn them as pairs.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: Direction (kam?) takes the accusative: grem v šolo. Place (kje?) takes the locative: sem v šoli.

exercises.instruction: Kateri kraji vzamejo 'na'? · Which places take na?
exercises.explain: na pošti, na tržnici, na trgu, na postaji, but v šoli and v gostilni. Open spaces and a few institutions take na.

exercises.text: Babica je ___ kuhinji. (Grandma is in the kitchen.)
exercises.explain: Rooms take v: v kuhinji, v spalnici, v kopalnici.

exercises.text: Grem na ___. (I'm going to the market.)
exercises.explain: Direction → accusative: tržnica → na tržnico. Once you're there: na tržnici.

exercises.text: Stanujem v ___. (I live in Nova Gorica.)
exercises.explain: Place → locative, and the adjective changes too: Nova Gorica → v Novi Gorici.

exercises.text: Jutri grem v ___. (Tomorrow I'm going to Gorizia.)
exercises.explain: Direction → accusative: Gorica → v Gorico. Compare: sem v Gorici, sem iz Gorice.

exercises.prompt: In the evening I'm at the inn.
exercises.explain: Place → v + locative: v gostilni. Gostilno would be the direction (grem v gostilno).

exercises.prompt: Tomorrow we're going to the post office.
exercises.explain: Direction → na + accusative: na pošto. Pošti would be the place (sem na pošti).

exercises.prompt: I'm going to the post office.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that you live in Trnovo and work in Nova Gorica.
exercises.say: Stanujem v Trnovem in delam v Novi Gorici.
accept: Živim v Trnovem in delam v Novi Gorici.
Živim v Trnovem, delam v Novi Gorici.
Stanujem v Trnovem, delam v Novi Gorici.
exercises.explain: Both are places → locative: v Trnovem (Trnovo declines like an adjective), v Novi Gorici.
